en.title: Kerala HC says investigating officer can also be appointed as prosecutor in court-martial case as per Navy regulations
en.summary: Kerala High Court ruled that an investigating officer may serve as prosecutor in a naval court-martial without violating the accused's right to fair trial under existing Navy regulations.

en.title: SPO disengaged over 'fake' records, Jammu and Kashmir High Court orders reinstatement
en.summary: Jammu and Kashmir High Court ordered the reinstatement of a Special Police Officer who was dismissed based on fraudulent records.

en.title: Railway Board sanction clears key hurdle for Bengaluru Metro Pink Line elevated section
en.summary: Railway Board approval has removed a significant obstacle for the Pink Line metro project in Bengaluru, which includes 7.5 km of elevated track and 13.8 km underground sections across a 21.3 km corridor.

en.title: IIT Bombay suicide: Sahil's locked iPhone holds clues on his exam-day 'search', cops left scrambling
en.summary: Police are unable to access data on a locked iPhone belonging to a deceased IIT Bombay student that may contain information about his activities on the day of his death.

en.title: IIT Bombay suicide case: Sahil Wakode's father detained on way to campus
en.summary: Mumbai Police detained Ravindra Wakode while he was traveling to protest his son's death at IIT Bombay. The second-year student died by suicide in September, with the investigation examining caste-based harassment allegations against a professor.

en.title: 'Take Wife's Name If Caught': Son Told Hitman Before UP Businessman's Murder
en.summary: Police arrested Subrat Manocha in connection with a businessman's murder in Uttar Pradesh. He has been taken into custody for court presentation.

en.summary: Rahul Gandhi, a political leader, contacted the parents of Sahil Wakode, the IIT Bombay student who died by suicide.

en.summary: A Kanpur businessman allegedly orchestrated a murder plot against his father and subsequently attempted to blame his wife for the crime.

en.title: 'Die then, we won't stop': Driver of bus that caught fire ignored passengers' pleas to stop
en.summary: A bus traveling from Delhi to Mahoba caught fire on the Yamuna Expressway after the driver ignored passengers' warnings about smoke, resulting in nine deaths and multiple severe burn injuries.

en.title: 'Take my wife's name': Twist in UP businessman murder as son emerges as mastermind
en.summary: The son of a drug trader was arrested as the alleged mastermind in his father's murder, with his wife implicated as an accomplice based on police evidence including a blood-stained cloth.

en.summary: Four men were arrested in Samastipur after a video showed them harassing a girl in public, following similar recent incidents in Jamui involving harassment of a minor by a group of youths.

en.title: PB Fintech loses Rs 22,700 cr from market value as stock crashes 26% after IRDAI's reform plans. What Citi and Jefferies are warning

en.summary: Sebi's board meeting will consider revising portfolio management services rules to permit new investment types including overseas assets, and expanding foreign portfolio investor access to commodity derivatives while reviewing accredited investor framework changes.

en.summary: Avantel's stock rose after securing a Rs 177.35 crore order from Zetwerk for satellite communication equipment to be delivered by March 2027, strengthening revenue visibility for the telecom and defence electronics manufacturer.

stories.title: IFCI, New India Assurance, other stocks drop up to 3% as NSE makes a muted market debut. What to expect?

en.title: IFCI, New India Assurance, other stocks drop up to 3% as NSE makes a muted market debut. What to expect?
en.summary: The National Stock Exchange's IPO listing resulted in a less than 1% premium over its offer price, while shares of IFCI, New India Assurance, and General Insurance Corporation declined up to 3%. Analysts remain optimistic about NSE's long-term prospects.
